spring-foraging.text: Spring is when the woods wake up. Walk the paths and look down. Give any 4 of the 6 things it asks for to finish it and take 15 parsnip seeds.

summer-foraging.text: Warm days bring berries and vines to the forage spots. Give any 3 of the 4 things it asks for to finish it and take 15 radish seeds.

autumn-foraging.text: Autumn hedges are heavy with fruit and nuts. Fill a basket before the frost. Give any 4 of the 6 things it asks for to finish it and take 15 beet seeds.

winter-foraging.text: Old Greencoat wants what the cold season gives: blooms in the snow, nuts and roots turned up by the hoe. Give any 3 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take a seed maker.

woodland.text: Fell trees, break rocks and clear the weeds. The hall needs a great deal of each. Give all 3 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a charcoal kiln.

rare-finds.text: Rare things turn up now and then on a forage spot or deep in the mine. Keep an eye out across the year. Give any 3 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take the heavy tapper recipe.

spring-crops.text: Plant these in spring. The shop sells the seeds. Give all 3 of the things it asks for to finish it and take 300 coins.

summer-crops.text: Summer crops love the heat. Plant them early in the season. Give all 3 of the things it asks for to finish it and take 400 coins.

autumn-crops.text: The autumn harvest for the larder shelves. The shop sells the seeds in fall. Give any 4 of the 6 things it asks for to finish it and take a bee house.

quality-crops.text: Five of three kinds, each one at least silver. Tend the soil, and fertilizer helps. Give any 3 of the 4 things it asks for to finish it and take a preserves jar.

animal-goods.text: Eggs from the coop and milk from the barn. Duck eggs, goat milk and wool come with the bigger buildings. Give any 4 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take a cheese press.

artisan-goods.text: Jars of jam and pickles, a comb of honey, or fruit from your own orchard. Give any 4 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take a keg.

smiths.text: Bars from the furnace: ore from the mine or the smith, and coal to smelt it. Give all 3 of the things it asks for to finish it and take 20 coal.

weavers.text: Wool from the sheep or rabbit, and plant fibre from the weeds. Give all 2 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a loom.

lamplighters.text: Light for the long evenings: standing lamps, oil from the press, or candles made from beeswax. Give any 2 of the 3 things it asks for to finish it and take a small glow ring.

dyers.text: Flowers and berries that colour cloth: spring daffodils, summer sweet peas, autumn cranberries and winter crocuses. Give any 4 of the 12 things it asks for to finish it and take a dye vat.

cooks.text: Three of the dishes the valley's kitchens are known for, hot from your own stove. Give any 3 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take 3 innkeeper's roast.

stream-fish.text: Fish the river from the farm to the delta. Some run only in one season, so keep a line in all year. Give any 3 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take 30 plain bait.

lake-fish.text: Still water: the forest lake, the mountain lake and the delta marsh. Give any 3 of the 4 things it asks for to finish it and take a glint lure.

sea-fish.text: Cast from the Beach. The sea gives different fish by the season. Give any 4 of the 6 things it asks for to finish it and take 5 beach warp totem.

night-fishing.text: Fish after dark, on lake, marsh and sea. A moth lure helps. Give any 3 of the 4 things it asks for to finish it and take a glow ring.

specialty-fish.text: One rare fish each from the river, a lake and the sea, and the Pearl Lobster. Rain, dawn and a good rod help. Give all 4 of the things it asks for to finish it and take 5 fisher's stew.

trap-catch.text: Shellfish from pots set in fresh and salt water. Bait the pot each day. Give any 5 of the 8 things it asks for to finish it and take 3 shellfish pot.

fodder.text: Hay from the silo or the carpenter, grain from the fields, and roots from the cellar. The coop will want a heater come winter. Give all 3 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a coop heater.

hosts.text: A table worth sitting at: bread, honey cake and a pot of herb tea. Give all 3 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a hat of your choice.

storytellers.text: Old things turn up under the hoe, and the quiet mine floors keep a few. Old Greencoat collects stories. Give any 3 of the 5 things it asks for to finish it and take a green-glass lantern.

harvest-feast.text: One of everything the valley's kitchens and cellars make: a meal, a preserve, a cheese and honey, three of each. Give all 4 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a crystalarium.

the-catch.text: The finest of each water: a stream, a lake, a sea and a night fish, all gold quality. Give all 4 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a magnet ring.

hearth-fire.text: Metal, light, cloth and colour to warm a hall for the long road. Oil stands in for lamps for now. Give all 4 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a big chest.

long-road.text: Supplies for the road past the bridge. Old Greencoat will write you a letter of introduction. Give all 4 of the things it asks for to finish it and take a letter to the elves.
